scope: Corollary 6.1 of the manuscript “Nagata's conjecture for plane curves” (preprints/Nagatas-Conjecture-for-Plane-Curves-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 039 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 42a8897d121e2fc0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be an uncountable algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let r ≥ 10. There is a countable union of proper Zariski-closed subsets of the space of distinct ordered r-tuples in P2 k, with nonempty complement, outside which the conclusion of Theorem 1.1 holds with the same degree and multiplicity conventions.
